decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The application for the erection of single storey rear and side extensions, as shown on drawing numbers S02, S03 & S04, received 13 September 2006 and P01, P02 (Rev A) & P03 (Rev 3), received 03 November 2006, is recommended for approval as by reason of its size, position and appearance, it would not harm the appearance of the existing building or the amenity of neighbouring properties and would preserve and enhance the appearance and character of Chiswick House Conservation Area. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations, and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
description: Erection of single storey rear and side extensions to the existing house.
